title: Improving Optimistic Concurrency Control Through Transaction Batching and Operation Reordering
relevance: State-of-the-art OCC with batching and reordering. Shows 2.2x throughput improvement through holistic batching. Principles directly applicable to batched DEFLATE block decode.

title: Challenging the 'embarrassingly sequential': parallelizing FSM-based computations through principled speculation
relevance: Establishes theoretical framework for when speculative parallel FSM execution is profitable. Directly applicable to speculative DEFLATE decode.

title: A 43.3 bit/cycle Inflate Accelerator Featuring Static-Dynamic Huffman Decoder with Multiple Checkpoints
relevance: Latest hardware DEFLATE accelerator using multiple checkpoints for speculative thread validation. Demonstrates the multi-checkpoint approach for hardware OCC-style decode.

title: Dual-Thread Deflate/Inflate Accelerator With Multicheckpoint Control
relevance: Most recent hardware dual-thread DEFLATE decompressor with checkpoint-based validation. Directly implements the OCC paradigm in hardware.
